steps.label: Unlock
steps.text: When Superman takes lethal damage for the first time, if at least one ally is still present, he survives with 1 HP instead and immediately consumes all Energy to cast his Ultimate. After Superman casts his Ultimate, he calls down a meteor, dealing physical damage equal to 400% of his Attack to enemies in a circular area and stunning them for 1s. [Stunned]: Incapacitates the target.
